html:
A series of wars between the Asante Empire and Britain over the coast and trade, from 1824 to 1900.

In 1824 Asante killed the British governor Charles MacCarthy at Nsamankow. In 1874 a British army under Garnet Wolseley took Kumasi and burned it, and Britain declared the coast the Gold Coast colony. In 1896 the British occupied Kumasi again and exiled King Prempeh I. In 1900 the demand for the Golden Stool led to the last war, led by Yaa Asantewaa. Asante was annexed in 1901. Prempeh returned in 1924, and the kingdom was restored in 1935 under British rule.
sum: A series of wars between the Asante Empire and Britain over the coast and trade, from 1824 to 1900.
